name: Cá khô nướng
summary: Cá khô nướng is dried fish grilled for the rice. The dried seafood is fragrant once it is cooked.
origin: Cham Islands. Dried seafood on Tân Hiệp, eaten with rice.
howToEat: Grill the dried fish. The 16 September 2025 study also allows the same dried fish simmered until the sauce coats it, as a separate plate.
With rice at the midday or evening meal. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00.
where: Bai Lang and the other hamlets.
seoTitle: Cá khô nướng — grilled dried fish, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Grilled dried fish in the daily rice on Tân Hiệp. The dried seafood is fragrant once it is cooked.
